beam.architecture:
BeamPredictionLSTMModel(
  (lstm_layers): LSTM(128, 128, batch_first=True)
  (shared_layers): Sequential()
  (output_heads): ModuleList(
    (0-3): 4 x Sequential(
      (0): VectorResBlock(
        (fc1): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn1): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (fc2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn2): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (relu): ReLU(inplace=True)
      )
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): VectorResBlock(
        (fc1): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn1): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (fc2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn2): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (relu): ReLU(inplace=True)
      )
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): VectorResBlock(
        (fc1): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn1): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (fc2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn2): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (relu): ReLU(inplace=True)
      )
      (5): ReLU()
      (6): VectorResBlock(
        (fc1): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=256, bias=False)
        (bn1): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (fc2): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=False)
        (bn2): BatchNorm1d(256, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (relu): ReLU(inplace=True)
        (downsample): Sequential(
          (0): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=256, bias=False)
          (1): BatchNorm1d(256, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

information.beam: five ordered predicted candidates, paid measurements at first available slot, fixed for remaining frame
information.forbidden: no full H or oracle-best-pair lookup in matching controller
information.load: predicted interference and predicted desired gains; last serving measurement replaces serving optimum when BS unchanged
information.matching: position, predicted optimal/interference gains, queues, mean arrival rates, estimated load, association
information.slot_ra: measured serving beam and same physical interference convention as frozen MEET/MTS

interpretation: Preliminary one-seed comparison, not an isolated information ablation; no tuning on these points.

overhead.explanation: 5 at first active slot; 1 in each other active slot; zero during HO

timing.beams: report[x] candidate list is probed in x+1, after interruption if applicable
timing.matching: report[x] drives association applied in x+1
timing.reference_caveat: frozen MEET BF uses cache[x] during x, although prediction target is x+1; reference not modified
